# Review #714: matched comparison 0155 correction (changed scope)

Verdict: **NOT-CLEAR**. One finding (F-N1) blocks it. F-M1 and F-M3 are resolved. F-M2 is only half resolved.

Pins (measured with python3 hashlib at HEAD 07dc83f0a52a171a4bb19b81dd88d395eeb4e8d3):
- `benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md` SHA256 `15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933`
- `benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json` SHA256 `04543bdacb7e356bb1ea46c4256659716b0e023066cab5bf29800d769f6e193b`

The verification command was not run as a single command. I did load the json with `json.load` in my extractions, and it parsed. I did not check the md size against 2000 bytes.

## Spec findings

- **F-N1 (medium, blocking): md/json parity break on M09.**
  - `/rules/M09` in the json is unchanged from the pre-correction text: "Unsupported cases or arms are recorded as answer_class unsupported and stay visible...".
  - The md M09 now says (a) an arm unavailable before dispatch is an unstarted slot with no answer_class, and (b) a dispatched attempt with answer_class unsupported is ineligible.
  - The json rule still treats an unsupported arm as answer_class unsupported. That is the conflation F-M2 asked to remove.
  - The json diff changed `/arms/with_images_rule`, `/stopping/mapping` and M04, but not M09.
  - Correction: update `/rules/M09` to the md (a)/(b) wording, including "`unsupported -> finished_incomplete` is only the plan-end derivation".
- F-M1 resolved.
  - The interruption row, in both md and json (`/stopping/mapping`), says `interrupted` alone never stops a plan (ledger R08).
  - It says stopped_hard_failure applies only with a separate stop_recorded `hard_evidence_failure`.
  - It otherwise derives the terminal by the ledger order. The ledger `terminal_derivation` says hard_evidence_failure > settings_drift > budget, else finished_incomplete or finished_complete. That is consistent.
- F-M2 partly resolved.
  - The md table and json mapping rows (a) and (b) are separated correctly and match the ledger. The ledger has no `unstarted` closure other than "derived at terminal", and the correction is consistent with that.
  - `/arms/with_images_rule` is also correct. The remaining gap is F-N1.
- F-M3 resolved.
  - M04, `/repetitions/rules` and md Repetitions state mechanism-only reuse.
  - This matches 0138: `independent_repetitions_per_case_arm` is null, there is one synthetic comparison with one no-tool and one tool slot, and no with-images slot appears.
  - No real count is invented. O06 is rewritten and stays open.
- The O01-O05 items are untouched and the diff adds no quality threshold.
- No unrelated rule changed in the diff against 27dc789b. The only changed json pointers are `/arms/with_images_rule`, `/repetitions/rules`, `/stopping/mapping` (interruption row, plus the unsupported row split in two), M04 and O06. The md changes are the same set plus M09.

## Standards findings

- None documented. The md/json drift in F-N1 is the only consistency problem.

## What next

Have the author fix `/rules/M09` in the json, then run a narrow re-check. Check only that md and json M09 match and that the rest of the diff is unchanged. Do not redo the #710 checks.

No changes to merge.
